title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Abstention and Refusal Reasoning in Vision--Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.05540v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many medical conditions require diagnosis through detailed, multi-context clinical assessment rather than from visual appearance alone. Despite this, vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly queried to interpret images in ways that touch on medical or diagnostic judgments, raising safety concerns when such inferences are unsupported. ASD diagnosis requires behavioral and developmental evidence, not static facial photographs. We audit whether VLMs abstain from this unanswerable paired-image query, and whether expressions sway non-abstaining choices.   We introduce PARITY (Paired Assessment with Reused Identity), a synthetic, demographically balanced set of identity-controlled neutral/expression portrait pairs with neutral-neutral controls. translated_title: 知道何时不该回答：视觉-语言模型中的弃答与拒绝推理
translated_abstract: 许多医疗状况需要通过详细的、多情境的临床评估来诊断，而不能仅凭视觉外观判断。尽管如此，视觉-语言模型越来越多地被要求以涉及医学或诊断判断的方式来解读图像，当此类推断缺乏依据时会引发安全担忧。自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的诊断需要行为和发育方面的证据，而非静态的面部照片。我们审查了视觉-语言模型是否会弃答这类无法回答的成对图像查询，以及表情是否会影响非弃答的选择。我们引入了PARITY（重用身份的成对评估）数据集，这是一个合成的、人口统计平衡的、身份受控的中性/表情人像对数据集，并配有中性-中性对照组。所有身份均为合成生成，且不具有ASD状态；由于该查询无法从图像中回答，任何非弃答的选择都被视为有害的归因。在当代视觉-语言模型中，我们……
tldr: 该论文提出了名为PARITY的合成人像对基准数据集，用于审计视觉-语言模型在面对无法从图像回答的医学诊断查询（如通过面部照片诊断自闭症）时是否会正确弃答，并将任何非弃答选择视为有害归因进行评估。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PARITY, a synthetic identity-controlled paired-portrait benchmark to audit whether vision-language models appropriately abstain from unanswerable medical diagnostic queries such as inferring ASD from facial photos, treating any non-abstaining selection as harmful attribution.
